Name: KOREA HANBOK scarecrow
Author: yrd9331
Description:
I turned a Korean historical drama character into a scarecrow.

You can replace the statue of Louis with the one of the kings.

The gold, iridium version has been created to replace the gold and iridium statues.

The attached file shows that the king and queen are in the position of the light, which gives rise to a halo in the evening.
I personally like it, so I use it as it is.

The character is placed in the position of the scarecrow and the brazier, and can be changed to the desired location.
